instruction: A lava rock outcrop: a clustered mass of dark fractured volcanic rock with sharp faceted edges, deep shadowed cavities and hollows, and a rough vesicular surface. Clean procedural stone forms, not scan noise.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a lava rock outcrop. A lava rock outcrop: a clustered mass of dark fractured volcanic rock with sharp faceted edges, deep shadowed cavities and hollows, and a rough vesicular surface. Clean procedural stone forms, not scan noise. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
